content.short: Shield gives international exporters US bank accounts and stablecoin payments that settle same-day as USD.
content.description: Shield is a crypto neobank built for global exporters, wholesalers and distributors who struggle with slow, jammed international wires. It lets companies accept USDT and stablecoin payments that arrive as US dollars the same day, open virtual US bank accounts with routing numbers approved within a day, and access business credit cards with revenue-based underwriting. Headquartered in Miami and reaching more than 120 countries, Shield is registered as a money service business with FinCEN and insured through Lloyd's of London. Backed by investors including a16z crypto, Kraken and MoonPay, it targets trade businesses that need fast, predictable settlement across corridors that correspondent banking handles slowly and expensively.
